fills.researcher_notes: wiki_alignment flagged the multi-segment wiki page unioning GTSOU onto a sheet cell that carries only Gazprom Transgaz Belarus JSC. RESOLVED AS A LEGITIMATE UNION, not a wiki artefact: VTG's own row states the line's countries as Belarus AND Ukraine, so the corridor genuinely has two operators — Gazprom Transgaz Belarus on the Belarusian section, GTSOU on the Ukrainian one since the 2020 unbundling. Tier MEDIUM rather than high because the conclusion is a two-step inference (VTG establishes the line crosses into Ukraine; ENTSOG/TSOUA establish GTSOU operates Ukraine's system) rather than one source naming both operators for this line. Independence: counted as two independent origins — ENTSOG's own membership register and Ukrtransgaz/TSOUA's own archived key-facts page. uk.wikipedia is carried as a reading aid for the Ukrainian-language corporate history and is NOT counted toward independence (tertiary encyclopaedia). Same ref triple used across this brief's rows, per the Leg-3 instruction to settle the operator question once per company.
